source_reference_scope: S01-S24 refer only to the companion foundation source register; these are document-local locators, not new canonical entity IDs.
purpose: Adversarial research examples for later contract mapping and test design. These are not executable tests or accepted production schemas.

cases.challenge: A newly generated clinical artifact is presented as historically valid evidence despite zero point-in-time backing.
cases.expected_behavior: Show generation freshness separately from observation freshness and historical coverage; retain legacy limitations.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Actual versioned source observations and point-in-time coverage receipts, not a fresh render timestamp.

cases.challenge: A therapeutic platform inherits a diagnostics-only interpretation because both are mapped to an old broad theme ID.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve existing IDs and introduce reviewed orthogonal research facets without automatically changing price memberships.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Existing-owner ontology mapping and consumer compatibility proof.

cases.challenge: A companion diagnostic is generalized to every drug, specimen or patient within an oncology category.
cases.expected_behavior: Bind the assertion to the actual assay, biomarker, specimen, therapeutic product and indication.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Relevant regulatory decision and label version.

cases.challenge: Regulatory approval is automatically converted to coverage, payment or treatment availability for all payers.
cases.expected_behavior: Keep regulatory, payer-policy and care-delivery assertions separate; unsupported transitions remain unknown.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Specific payer geography, eligibility policy, effective date and delivery capability.

cases.challenge: A trial population is copied into the approved indication without considering the regulator's actual scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve study population, label population and any stated extrapolation as separate evidence.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Dated regulatory scope and the original study context; no automatic age or indication substitution.

cases.challenge: A historically pending manufacturing authorization is asserted to remain pending today.
cases.expected_behavior: Retain the historical assertion and mark current status unresolved until refreshed.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Later site/product authorization or commercial-release receipt.

cases.challenge: An opening ceremony is treated as proof of approved and operating commercial production.
cases.expected_behavior: Separate facility opening, regulatory qualification, production start and realized output.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Each stage's own dated evidence.

cases.challenge: Planned future payload-linker capacity is counted in current supply or as proof of industry shortage.
cases.expected_behavior: Keep future plans, current qualified output and shortage evidence distinct.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Commissioning and qualification plus comparable supply-demand observations.

cases.challenge: Different isotope and product observations are merged into one timeless radiopharmaceutical shortage claim.
cases.expected_behavior: Require isotope, product, geography, time and units; reject unscoped aggregation.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Current underlying supply evidence; search-only DOE material cannot support a quantified accepted constraint.

cases.challenge: A technology licensing agreement is promoted into an asset-specific manufacturing relationship.
cases.expected_behavior: Represent only the disclosed licensed rights and assigned responsibilities.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: A distinct manufacturing contract or direct disclosure naming the relevant scope.

cases.challenge: An undisclosed target is guessed from a company's other programs and treated as fact.
cases.expected_behavior: Keep the target undisclosed and quarantine semantic guesses as hypotheses.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Explicit source disclosure and a qualified mapping.

cases.challenge: An unnamed customer in a supply announcement is matched to a prominent product without evidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Retain an unnamed counterparty and prohibit a synthetic company-product supply edge.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Direct counterparty or contract evidence.

cases.challenge: A net profit-sharing percentage is applied to gross product sales as the partner's revenue exposure.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve the contractual and accounting basis; do not calculate an unsupported revenue share.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Disclosed relevant revenue, costs, adjustments and partner accounting.

cases.challenge: A company's entire reported revenue is allocated independently to every associated theme.
cases.expected_behavior: Permit overlapping discovery while avoiding additive double counting; undisclosed allocation remains unknown.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Business/product-period disclosure and an accepted aggregation policy.

cases.challenge: Today's registry record is used to reconstruct historical phase, sponsorship or membership.
cases.expected_behavior: Require contemporaneous snapshots or explicit historical source versions; expose gaps.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Actual history coverage through the existing BioCatalyst owner.

cases.challenge: A primary-completion date becomes a guaranteed company readout or publication date.
cases.expected_behavior: Separate endpoint-data collection, study completion, public result posting and sponsor guidance.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: The correct event-specific source, status and date precision.

cases.challenge: Study registrations, estimated enrollment or Phase 3 counts are labelled measured spending or commercial success.
cases.expected_behavior: Keep descriptive activity separate from economic measurement and predictive validation.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Independent expenditure evidence or a predeclared, point-in-time evaluation with suitable controls.

cases.challenge: The FDA AI list is treated as an exhaustive universe or its entry count as paid adoption.
cases.expected_behavior: Expose source coverage limits and require a separate commercial-use denominator.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Version-scoped authorization evidence and actual deployment or usage evidence.

cases.challenge: Every device pathway is labelled drug-like approval, or a device identifier is treated as a listed issuer.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve authorization type and namespace-specific identity; resolve company/security through existing owners.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Submission details and a qualified entity join.

cases.challenge: A quarterly report's fiscal end is assigned to subsequent-event narrative, or a dataset release date replaces its observation year.
cases.expected_behavior: Track observation interval, publication date and event-effective date independently.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Each assertion's actual temporal locator, preserving unknown precision.

cases.challenge: Fee-for-service payer spending is substituted for all-payer utilization or global manufacturer net revenue.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve population exclusions, coding unit and accounting basis; require explicit reconciliation.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Comparable code/product mappings, periods, populations and financial disclosures.

cases.challenge: An enabling platform's new license or contingent milestone is counted as realized recurring product economics.
cases.expected_behavior: Separate signed rights, contingencies, launched partner products and recognized revenue channels.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Actual reported royalties or product sales and applicable contract scope.

cases.challenge: A government-hosted composite terminology is declared entirely unrestricted for redistribution.
cases.expected_behavior: Check component-level rights and keep access permission separate from publication permission.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: Relevant source terms and existing rights-owner approval; no unlicensed corpus import.

cases.challenge: An accessible research page or local example bypasses the existing protected evidence path, or an inaccessible web read is generalized to total provider outage.
cases.expected_behavior: Retain existing custody/publication boundaries and scope failures to the tested path. Local research fixtures grant no product or trade authority.
cases.evidence_to_resolve: An authorized source-feasibility receipt and real-path authenticated consumer proof when implementation is commissioned.
